fixed.problem: Review blocking item 2 (L4-money-207 sibling; money rule 'never more'): after a crash, the Update kept offering Continue after a later session of the project had begun. Bench walk 7 did Continue, then Stop now on the continuation. The Update offered 'the CHF 1.00 left of its budget' again, and a second Continue started another session with all of it. Root cause, part 1: crashContinueOf (daemon/views.ts) did not check for a later session, although waitBlockOf does. Part 2: POST /sessions with `continues` gave the earlier session's cap less its own spend, and did not take off what a session that already went on with it had used.
fixed.failing_test_before: apps/ui/test/real-daemon.test.ts 'l4-starts-sessions, run L4' > 'L4-money-207: once a later session of the project began, the crash Update offers no Continue, and a Continue sent after it gets only what is left'. Before the fix the Update kept its Continue. With only the Update fixed, the second Continue's cap was still the whole rest: expected 6233130, got 6243183. Also apps/ui/test/inbox.test.tsx 'the Update shows Continue with what it does; the press opens Start ...': no POST /messages/msg_crash/read happened on the press.
fixed.how: crashContinueOf offers Continue only while no non-planning session of the project has begun since the interrupted one ended. This is the same rule as waitBlockOf. POST /sessions with `continues` now takes off, from what is left, what each session that already went on with that session used (found through `plan.startedBy.continues`): its spend once it has ended, or its whole cap while it still runs. The Continue press also marks the Update read (InboxPage CrashContinue onPress). markRead keeps the row's derived action until the next read of the Inbox, so the open Start dialog stays. The fake daemon follows both rules: a later-session check in the crash Continue, and a continuesOf map used by the POST /sessions continues guard (cleared on reset). New UI case: 'once a later session of the project began the Update offers no Continue, only Mark read'. Docs: runtime.md, apps.md, the user guide, and a dated addition to the ADR 0118 L4-money-207 amendment.
fixed.check_in_the_app: Live check (session lead, real model): 1) Start a CHF 1.00 session on a project with one ready task. While it works, end Forerunner hard (Task Manager), then reopen it. 2) Inbox > Updates shows 'Your last session was interrupted when Forerunner closed. "X" is ready again.' with Continue and 'Opens Start with the rest of your last session and the CHF 0.99 left of its budget.' 3) Press Continue. The Start dialog opens, the Update turns read, and Start goes on with that budget. 4) On the new session's page press Stop now. The task is Ready again. 5) Back in Inbox > Updates the line has no Continue any more. 6) Start the project again: it is a new session with its own budget, not a second continuation. Bench evidence: /tmp/frbench/fixup-l4-starts-sessions-after-steps/01-after-crash-update-continue.png, 02-after-continue-press-dialog.png, 03-after-stop-update-no-continue.png and walk207.json. In the walk the stale Continue got cap 1233147 = 1243192 left - 10045 spent by the continuation.

notes_for_other_areas: LastSessionOutcome.pausedByYou?: NamedTask[] (session/result.ts, append-only): tasks the person paused (Pause or Stop) while the session ran them, still paused by them at its end. It is not part of needsYou. SessionRecord.pausedByYou? (session-list.ts) is optional.

The result builder 'cancelled by you' now also says the person's pause in one sentence ('You cancelled "A" and paused "B"; nothing else ran.'). NOT_NEWS matches 'You (cancelled|paused) .+?; nothing else ran.'.
stillBlocked (daemon/views.ts) skips outcome.pausedByYou tasks while isPausedByPerson. The Overview's sinceLines input skips them too.
crashContinueOf hides Continue once any non-planning session of the project was created after the interrupted one ended. Its rule matches waitBlockOf.

POST /sessions with `continues`: left = cap - spent - what sessions with plan.startedBy.continues === that id took (their spend once ended, their whole cap while working). The fake daemon keeps state.continuesOf (session id to the session it continued) for the same rule, and reset clears it.
InboxPage markRead keeps a row's derived `action` when the read route answers, until the next GET /inbox.
